headline: Google Wallet combines phone and watch transactions in one place
summary: Google Wallet now shows all transactions in one place
details: The Google Wallet app now combines transactions made on both phone and Wear OS smartwatch. This update, rolling out now, lets users see all their spending in one place.
Previously, users had to check both their phone and smartwatch apps to tally their spending. The update addresses this issue by syncing transactions across devices.

Transactions are marked with 'Purchase made on watch' when made on a Wear OS device. However, only the last 10 purchases are visible in the app; users can view their full transaction history on the Google Wallet website.
caption:
Can you track all your Google Wallet transactions in one place now?
